## 💡 Feature Overview
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen or what problem this solves.

## 👤 User Scenario / Motivation
*Why* would this feature be useful?
- *e.g., "I want to track my multi-ride train ticket, but I need to be able to set custom notification times..."*

## 🎨 Suggested Solution / Design Ideas (Optional)
Describe how you imagine this feature working or where it should live in the app.

## 🔍 Additional Context
Add any other context which would help design the feature as closely as you wanted.
